_readme: Template for enhanced.json. Nothing here is live; the player only reads enhanced.json.
The /otr setting 'enhanced audio when available' plays an entry's url instead of the catalog copy. Unmapped episodes play the regular copy.
Policy is subtractive only: declick, dehiss, hum, dropouts, or a better transfer of the same performance. Entries with method 'generative' are ignored.
url must be a direct https file that sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (archive.org download URLs do). No YouTube, Mixcloud, Spotify or web pages. Do not rehost on the droplet.
Keys: 'showId|YYYY-MM-DD|Title' (title is case and punctuation blind), 'showId||Title' when the title is unique in that show, or the archive filename stem.
duration is the enhanced file's runtime in seconds. On live channels it plays only when within 2 s of the catalog runtime; otherwise live plays the original and on-demand plays the enhanced copy.
An entry with url null is ignored, so placeholders are safe.
